RESOLVED 2026-10-19 (owner): keep generating, and disclose that we created it. The platform already does, in four places — an 'AI-generated' badge, a tooltip naming the exact four input fields, a 'May contain inaccuracies — verify against official sources' footnote, and a per-sentence attribution panel exposing the source/training split. So the eval's job is to reduce the unsourced share, not to gate publication.

One disclosure wording is itself inaccurate and is NOT covered by the decision above: the footnote says 'Generated from public record data', but the bio is generated from four structured fields — the public record page was never read (#1381/#1383). The tooltip is precise; this line overstates the grounding.
